nodes.text: In joy and gladness they were united;
afterwards they were parted in sorrow and grief.
A slanderer of the kingdom has beguiled them all;
his name was Tomile, a deadly traitor.
May the Lord God, who suffered on the cross, confound him!
There was once at Cologne a wicked traitor:
